nodes.label: accionDe(fila) rule
nodes.rationale: Single decision function drives title, PATCH body, buttons, report and export.

nodes.label: Fusion de tres herramientas en pestanas
nodes.norm_label: fusion de tres herramientas en pestanas
nodes.rationale: Evita saltar entre tres paginas; motores copiados tal cual envueltos en IIFE porque declaran los mismos nombres globales; marcado en <template> y desmontaje total al cambiar de pestana porque comparten ids.

nodes.label: Envoltorio IIFE por motor
nodes.rationale: logica-qdn.js y logica-qdn-operaciones.js van en un mismo IIFE porque operaciones referencia variables sueltas de logica-qdn.js.

nodes.label: Carga de paquetes (Consumos 1.8.0)
nodes.rationale: Only write in the suite besides Casos and HLR Claro; isolated IIFE window.MEPAQ; order built from cart response; no productOrder retry since CM does not deduplicate.

nodes.label: CM ChangeOffer order (cart + productOrder) to delete bundles
nodes.norm_label: cm changeoffer order (cart + productorder) to delete bundles
nodes.rationale: CM has no delete-bundle; cart with all plan products marked NO_CHANGE/DELETE; always delete cart.

nodes.label: CM stable fingerprint wait (bundleId:asignado)
nodes.rationale: Re-read until fingerprint changes and repeats twice; up to 15 tries every 2s.

nodes.label: ERCRT1002 missing dependent product handling
nodes.rationale: crearCarrito adds dependent product as NO_CHANGE and retries up to MAX_DEPENDENCIAS (10).

nodes.label: NO_ELIMINABLES bundle list
nodes.rationale: Bundles CM reports enabled but rejects on removal (e.g. 394 Promo 1x1); one rejected option fails whole order.

nodes.label: PLU sequence (consultar, aplicar, evidencia, eliminar, verificar)
nodes.norm_label: plu sequence (consultar, aplicar, evidencia, eliminar, verificar)
nodes.rationale: One PLU at a time so evidence and deletion of bundles do not mix.

nodes.label: Tulio RecargaPaquete
nodes.rationale: Success requires both estado fields '000', not just HTTP 200; timeouts not retried to avoid double recharge.

nodes.label: Guardas: solo precio 0, una linea, sin reintento de orden
nodes.norm_label: guardas: solo precio 0, una linea, sin reintento de orden
nodes.rationale: Captura HAR solo muestra agregado sin cobro; el CM no deduplica productOrder; verificacion contra subscriberProfile y no contra el 200; carrito se borra siempre.

nodes.label: Regla de no inventar datos
nodes.rationale: Distinguir 'No Registra' (afirmacion del HLR) de '—' (no vino el dato) y 'Sin datos' en bloqueos; una linea inactiva sale con todo en '—' para no mostrar datos afirmativos falsos.

nodes.label: Division de rangos y enriquecimiento de casos
nodes.norm_label: division de rangos y enriquecimiento de casos

nodes.label: convertir_audio_mp3.html (Convertir audio a MP3 | ME Operación)
nodes.norm_label: convertir_audio_mp3.html (convertir audio a mp3 | me operacion)

nodes.label: Local browser MP3 conversion (Web Audio + lamejs + JSZip)
nodes.norm_label: local browser mp3 conversion (web audio + lamejs + jszip)
nodes.rationale: No audio leaves the machine.

nodes.label: Interface guard user allowlist (not access control)
nodes.norm_label: interface guard user allowlist (not access control)
nodes.rationale: Prevents accidental writes, but shared API key means anyone with it can call the service.

nodes.label: Titular/document resolution flow (MSISDN -> BAN -> billingAccount -> Individual)
nodes.norm_label: titular/document resolution flow (msisdn -> ban -> billingaccount -> individual)
nodes.rationale: Walks up to 5 account levels, fullName fallback and billingAccount.id as individualID fallback from Postman; must stay aligned across consumos, rechazo and ajustes.

nodes.label: Portability rejection PDF (jsPDF, FC/LS/LD)
nodes.rationale: Replaces three Excel macros; PDF 12-35 KB vs 217 KB to avoid truncation on upload.

nodes.label: actualizar.bat manual updater
nodes.rationale: Never auto-installs; verifies SHA-256 before applying.

nodes.label: dame click.bat launcher
nodes.rationale: Console-only interaction; never crashes mid-flow, offers retry; update is a separate manual step (actualizar.bat).

nodes.label: DPAPI-encrypted stored credentials
nodes.rationale: Stored per Windows user in %APPDATA%\reporte_prepagadas; not usable on another machine/user.

nodes.label: New tool registration (me-ui.js APPS + logica-inicio.js PROYECTOS)
nodes.norm_label: new tool registration (me-ui.js apps + logica-inicio.js proyectos)
nodes.rationale: Tool must be registered in both places with matching id passed to MEUI.init().

nodes.label: No inventar datos principle
nodes.rationale: If CM does not return a field it stays empty or '—'; never infer a CC.

nodes.label: Major.Minor.Patch versioning convention
nodes.rationale: Adopted from release 2.2.0; historical versions normalized (2.2 == 2.2.0); never reuse a published number.

nodes.label: Three-layer tool architecture (HTML markup / logica-*.js / me-*-puente.js)
nodes.norm_label: three-layer tool architecture (html markup / logica-*.js / me-*-puente.js)
nodes.rationale: Keeps business rules out of HTML; shared services live in me-api.js/me-ui.js so each tool stays consistent and rules are not duplicated.

nodes.label: version.json as final version authority
nodes.rationale: actualizar.ps1 rewrites published version after copying ZIP so a stale scripts/VERSION does not cause repeated downloads; JSON UTF-8 no BOM, NFC, \uXXXX escapes.

nodes.label: Edge --disable-web-security over file://
nodes.rationale: Needed to bypass CORS against CM/Keycloak; local proxy server attempt blocked.

nodes.label: Replacing Excel macros with self-contained HTML tools
nodes.norm_label: replacing excel macros with self-contained html tools
nodes.rationale: Copy-paste between SIME, CM and spreadsheets caused truncated files, mixed naming, stale data.

nodes.label: Exact externalID billingAccount match
nodes.rationale: billingAccount?externalID is not an equality query; limit=10 and exact match to avoid operating on a foreign account (caused CM 500 on delete).

nodes.label: Ciclos apilados (pague N lleve M)
nodes.rationale: La cobertura combinada es el rango min(mes vigente)->max(mes fin), no la suma de meses.

nodes.label: El plan es el campo maestro
nodes.norm_label: el plan es el campo maestro
nodes.rationale: Al cambiar de plan se recalculan ID tipo, canal y PLU 1a compra; antes de v7.2 heredar el canal causaba 400 en SIME.

nodes.label: Operaciones bloqueo/desbloqueo/conciliacion
nodes.rationale: Escriben en produccion; archivo separado que reusa token, filas y filtros de logica-qdn.js; doble confirmacion y bitacora.

nodes.label: Arquitectura marcado / logica / puente
nodes.rationale: Cada herramienta separa HTML solo marcado, logica-<herramienta>.js con reglas de negocio y me-<herramienta>-puente.js como enganche con el shell comun.

nodes.label: Orden de carga me-ui -> MEUI.init -> me-api -> logica -> puente
nodes.norm_label: orden de carga me-ui -> meui.init -> me-api -> logica -> puente
nodes.rationale: MEUI.init() va antes de la logica porque mueve el contenido dentro del shell y consume los parametros que deja el lanzador en la URL.

nodes.label: CM ChangeSubscriptionState order
nodes.rationale: Activate (10005) not included until confirmed by a real captured order.

nodes.label: Consulta paralela Promise.all por linea
nodes.rationale: La concurrencia (5 por defecto) cuenta lineas, no peticiones: cada linea dispara 2 llamadas; duplica lo minimo de cada motor.

nodes.label: RETCODE Tigo (0 Activa, 3001 Sin perfil, 1033 Residuo)
nodes.norm_label: retcode tigo (0 activa, 3001 sin perfil, 1033 residuo)

nodes.label: HLR Ambos engine / logica-hlr-cruzado deliberate copies
nodes.norm_label: hlr ambos engine / logica-hlr-cruzado deliberate copies
nodes.rationale: Deliberate copies that may diverge; changes to one must be reviewed in the other.

nodes.label: Regla de conclusion Claro vs Tigo
nodes.norm_label: regla de conclusion claro vs tigo
nodes.rationale: Claro no distingue 'no existe' de 'inactiva' (ambos operationalState=inactive); Tigo aporta tres senales por RETCODE, asi que la conclusion combina ambas.

nodes.label: El 3001 no prueba que el numero sea de ME
nodes.norm_label: el 3001 no prueba que el numero sea de me
nodes.rationale: Sin perfil en HLR Tigo no implica pertenencia a Movil Exito; hay que cruzarlo con el estado en el CM/Optiva (estadoCM opcional).
